name: tpl-precedence-1-nogoal
task: If you reach the exit, you must have flipped the switch first.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: the task's only requirement is conditional (if the agent reaches the exit, it must have toggled the switch first), so the hard Precedence(switch_toggled, at_exit) captures it. The empty FINAL_STATES and rule-only warning are correct because no event is commanded unconditionally, and the machine's reject on at_exit before any switch_toggled matches the restriction.

texts: If the agent reaches the exit, it must have toggled the switch at an earlier step.
machine:
REWARD_MACHINE:
STATES: u0, u1, u2
INITIAL_STATE: u0
FINAL_STATES:
REJECTING_STATES: u2
DEFAULT_REWARD: 0
TRANSITION_FUNCTION:
(u0, !at_exit&switch_toggled) -> u1
(u0, at_exit&!switch_toggled) -> u2
(u0, at_exit&switch_toggled) -> u1
REWARD_FUNCTION:
(u0, at_exit&!switch_toggled, u2) -> -10
